notes: Objective is to ensure that all water ways shall have the required easement in compliance with the Water Code of the Philippines and the Supreme Court Mandamus. Locations: all Minor and Major Rivers, Creeks and the like. Regulations: no building or any structure shall be allowed along the easement; easement should have permeable flooring so that water can penetrate the sub surface; three (3) meters easement throughout the entire length of all waterways pursuant to the Water Code of the Philippines, except areas with specific easement requirements, namely a mandatory 7.50 meters easement designed for the CAMANAVA Flood Control Drainage Improvement Program for clearing/dredging of waterways along the polder dike in Brgy. Dampalit from Kailugan Floodgate up to North Pinagkabalian Floodgate (approx. length 6.10 km) and portions of the left banks of Malabon-Navotas River. Note: the section text calls this "overlay zone" in its objective statement although it is enumerated as a Base Zone.

notes: An area occupied by or intended principally for general types of institutional establishments, e.g. government offices, hospitals/clinics, academic/research and convention centers and the like. Shall be characterized by government and protective uses as well as institutional and social services for the entire City, and further by specialized government agencies providing institutional, protective, security and social services for the region or the country as a whole and which are governed by specialized regulations, including mental hospital, rehabilitation and training centers, military and security services. Nuclear, radioactive, chemical and biological warfare facilities are expressly excluded. Building Density and Bulk Regulations: per the relevant provisions of the NBC and this Ordinance; subject to national locational guidelines and standards of concerned agencies; areas located in flood risk shall observe safety regulations under the Flood Overlay Zone.
